metas.name: You Can See Everything
metas.description: Từng được tung hô với tham vọng thay đổi thế giới công nghệ, nữ founder này lại trở thành tâm điểm của một vụ lừa đảo đình đám khiến cả thế giới chấn động. Đằng sau lời hứa táo bạo và hình ảnh hào nhoáng ấy che giấu sự thật gì?

metas.name: Musk
metas.description: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded 'inventor-entrepreneur' who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

metas.name: Jackass: Chơi Lớn Lần Cuối
metas.description: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

metas.name: Clown Panic
metas.description: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.

metas.name: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
metas.description: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

metas.name: NAZA
metas.description: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.

metas.name: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind the Magic
metas.description: Featuring interviews from members of the casting, production design, costume design, and creature effects teams, follow the behind-the-scenes journey of bringing the Harry Potter books to the small screen. Find out how the new Golden Trio were found, and celebrate the commitment to detail of the artists, craftspeople, and technicians who have come together to bring the wizarding world to life.

metas.name: Che đậy
metas.description: Ông đã cống hiến cả sự nghiệp để vạch trần những câu chuyện mà giới quyền lực muốn chôn vùi. Từ Mỹ Lai đến Abu Ghraib, hãy khám phá sự nghiệp cả đời của phóng viên Seymour Hersh.

metas.name: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special
metas.description: Filmed in front of a live studio audience and hosted by Alex Cooper of 'Call Her Daddy' fame, Miley Cyrus reflects on the creation and impact of the series with never-before-seen archival footage, all the while interacting and reminiscing on some of the show's most memorable sets 'brought back to life' — including the Stewart family living room and the legendary Hannah Montana closet.

metas.name: Kỷ Niệm 20 Năm Harry Potter: Trở Lại Hogwarts
metas.description: Dàn diễn viên của cả 8 phần phim Harry Potter tái ngộ để mừng kỉ niệm năm thứ 20 của phim đầu tiên trong cả thương hiệu, Harry Potter Và Hòn Đá Phù Thủy.

metas.name: Vampire Secrets
metas.description: At the mention of the word "vampire," images of bloody fangs, dark capes, and a man with a hideous, spooky laugh immediately come to mind.  These conventional images, born from countless vampire films over the years, are most commonly associated with Irish writer Bram Stoker and his iconic 1897 novel Dracula. However, despite the popularity and influence of this celebrated nineteenth-century tome, the vampire myth dates back more than 1,000 years, long before Stoker ever put pen to paper. In this fascinating journey through time, HISTORY uncovers the ancient folkloric origins of blood-craving creatures from beyond the grave. Learn how the vampire myth is strongly rooted in Eastern European lore, but how it has also played a prominent role in the ancient cultures of Greece and China.  From wooden stakes to garlic apotropes to ancient burial rituals, VAMPIRE SECRETS explores how this long-standing myth has been interpreted by different cultures around the world.

metas.name: Instadocs: AI Mất Kiểm Soát
metas.description: Có phải AI đã phạm trọng tội? "Instadocs" điều tra vụ hack Hugging Face và lý do vụ tấn công mạng này có thể là phát súng cảnh báo cho tương lai của nhân loại.

metas.name: Climate Criminals?
metas.description: Are they the disgraceful vandals who pose a high risk to society? Climate Criminals? is a short documentary that records front-line climate activists reclaiming their actions in their own words.

metas.name: Phi Đội Máy Bay Cảm Tử 100 - The Bloody Hundredth
metas.description: Gặp gỡ các phi công ngoài đời thực, những người đã truyền cảm hứng cho bộ phim Bá Chủ Bầu Trời khi họ chia sẻ những sự kiện đau buồn và biến đổi của Nhóm ném bom 100.

metas.name: Đường Hầm Bồ Câu - The Pigeon Tunnel
metas.description: Diễn viên đoạt giải Oscar là Errol Morris vén tấm màn về cuộc đời và sự nghiệp của David Cornwell, cựu điệp viên vốn nổi danh trên văn đàn với cái tên John le Carré.

metas.name: Monster Maker
metas.description: A documentary about Stan Winston, the legendary special effects artist behind some of the most memorable and terrifying creatures ever put on screen.

metas.name: Val
metas.description: For over 40 years Val Kilmer, one of Hollywood's most mercurial and/or misunderstood actors, has been documenting his own life and craft through film and video. He has amassed thousands of hours of footage, from 16mm home movies made with his brothers, to time spent in iconic roles for blockbuster movies like Top Gun, The Doors, Tombstone, and Batman Forever. This raw, wildly original and unflinching documentary reveals a life lived to extremes and a heart-filled, sometimes hilarious look at what it means to be an artist and a complex man.

metas.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
metas.description: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

metas.name: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
metas.description: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

metas.name: Billie Eilish: Thế Giới Mơ Hồ - Billie Eilish: The World's a Little Blurry
metas.description: Phim tài liệu này mang đến góc nhìn chân thật về nghệ sĩ tuổi teen Billie Eilish. Cùng nhà làm phim nổi tiếng R.J. Cutler theo Billie lưu diễn, biểu diễn và sinh hoạt tại nhà trong khi cô viết và thu âm album đầu tay làm thay đổi cuộc đời mình.

metas.name: Magnum Dopus
metas.description: A behind the scenes look at the making of Jay & Silent Bob Reboot.

metas.name: Beloved Count
metas.description: Cult director Jess Franco recalls the making of his adaptation of Bram Stoker's Dracula starring Christopher Lee.

metas.name: Cuộc phiêu lưu cuối: Hậu trường Cậu bé mất tích 5
metas.description: Khám phá những năm tháng dày công và tài nghệ làm phim đằng sau mùa cuối cùng của loạt phim định hình cả một thế hệ do anh em nhà Duffer thực hiện.

metas.name: Euphoria: A Look Back
metas.description: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

metas.name: Selfie King
metas.description: Take a magical journey through the eyes of Terrifier 2's Selfie Guy. 3 years of interviews shot completely in selfie mode. Tons of celebrity cameos and seeing the ups and down in the film world. Director Rick Styczynski brings to light the cult madness of Selfie King.

metas.name: Superpower Dogs
metas.description: The life-saving superpowers and extraordinary bravery of some of the world’s most amazing dogs. The film follows six pups on their adventures: Halo, a puppy training to join an elite American disaster response team; Henry; an avalanche rescue dog in the Canadian Rockies; Reef, a Newfoundland lifeguard in the Italian Coast Guard; Ricochet, a surf and therapy boi in California; and the dynamic duo Tipper and Tony, who work to save endangered species in Africa.

metas.name: Olympia
metas.description: Follow Academy Award winner Olympia Dukakis behind the scenes in this affectionate profile of a stalwart New Yorker and beloved stage and screen treasure.

metas.name: Chinh Phục Cột Mốc Cuối Cùng: K2 Giữa Mùa Đông - The Last First: Winter K2
metas.description: Cuộc đua lịch sử để tiên phong lên đỉnh K2 vào mùa đông đã biến thành thảm kịch, phơi bày tham vọng, cái tôi và khát vọng vinh quang cũng có thể chết chóc như chính ngọn núi ấy.

metas.name: Stop Making Sense
metas.description: A concert film documenting Talking Heads at the height of their popularity, on tour for their 1983 album "Speaking in Tongues." The band takes the stage one by one and is joined by a cadre of guest musicians for a career-spanning and cinematic performance that features creative choreography and visuals.

metas.name: Marty, cuộc đời ngắn lắm
metas.description: Martin Short nhìn lại cuộc đời ngập tràn niềm vui qua bộ phim tài liệu với những đoạn clip kinh điển, các cuộc phỏng vấn mới và thước phim gia đình chưa công bố có dàn sao góp mặt.

metas.name: Jackass: Mãi Mãi Những Trò Dại
metas.description: Kẻ liều lĩnh khó đoán Johnny Knoxville tái xuất cùng những người bạn cũ và mới để tham gia hàng loạt pha hành động nguy hiểm kỳ lạ cũng như vô vàn trò lố bịch hài hước khác.

metas.name: Lorne
metas.description: An unprecedented, behind-the-scenes glimpse at the man who built the inimitable empire of comedy, shaping television and culture for generations. The documentary features exclusive footage, archival treasures, and candid interviews with the show’s most iconic cast members and writers including Tina Fey, Maya Rudolph, John Mulaney, Andy Samberg, Conan O’Brien, Chris Rock and many more.

metas.name: NWR
metas.description: A documentary about Danish director Nicolas Winding Refn, winner of the Best Director award at the Cannes Festival in 2011 for Drive. From his childhood to the shooting of his next movie, Only God Forgives, in Thailand, discover the whole career of a truly visionary filmmaker. With Ryan Gosling, Mads Mikkelsen, Alejandro Jodorowsky, Gaspar Noé, Peter Peter and Zlatko Buric.

metas.name: Cuadecuc, vampir
metas.description: An atmospheric essay, which is an alternative version of Count Dracula, a film directed by Jess Franco in 1970; a ghostly narration between fiction and reality.

metas.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi: Sự Trở Lại Của Jedi
metas.description: This special explores the return of Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to the screen, as well as Ewan McGregor and Hayden Christensen to their classic roles. Director Deborah Chow leads the cast and crew as they create new heroes and villains that live alongside new incarnations of beloved Star Wars characters, and an epic story that dramatically bridges the saga films.

metas.name: Overnight
metas.description: Alternately hilarious and horrifying, Overnight chronicles one man's misadventures of making a Hollywood movie. It starts out as a rags to riches story as Troy Duffy, a Boston-bred bartender, sells his first screenplay for The Boondock Saints.

metas.name: Batman Featurette
metas.description: A documentary about the making of 'Batman' (1966). Actors Burt Ward and Adam West tell stories from the set, the casting and other events.

metas.name: #NoJoke
metas.description: A musician's journey to create a song with some of the biggest stars in the industry. Along the way, he faces up to his painful past, while giving viewers a deep personal insight into the issue of bullying.

metas.name: Avatar: The Deep Dive - A Special Edition of 20/20
metas.description: An inside look at one of the most anticipated movie sequels ever with James Cameron and cast.

metas.name: Combat America
metas.description: Produced in 1943 under the guidance of Army Air Force Lieutenant Clark Gable, this film follows a single 8th Air Force B-17 crew from training through a series of missions over Europe.

metas.name: Junket Whore
metas.description: A documentary film that explores the relationship between publicists and journalists in Hollywood.

metas.name: Always Lalisa
metas.description: Đằng sau ánh hào quang của một siêu sao toàn cầu là hành trình đi tìm chính mình.  Always Lalisa đưa khán giả bước vào một năm đặc biệt trong cuộc đời LISA – khi cô tạm rời Blackpink để lần đầu tiên thực sự bước đi trên con đường solo, đối diện với những câu hỏi chưa từng có lời giải: Nếu không có Blackpink, LISA là ai? Và cô muốn trở thành ai?  Từ những khoảnh khắc trong phòng thu khi cô tạo nên album solo đầu tay Alter Ego, đến bước ngoặt diễn xuất trong The White Lotus và màn trình diễn solo tại Coachella 2025, bộ phim hé lộ hành trình phía sau những sân khấu rực rỡ – nơi LISA phải đối mặt với áp lực, sự kỳ vọng và ánh nhìn không ngừng của thế giới.  Sinh ra tại Thái Lan, rời quê nhà từ năm 14 tuổi để theo đuổi giấc mơ K-pop tại Hàn Quốc, LISA đã đi một chặng đường dài để trở thành biểu tượng toàn cầu. Nhưng khi tự mình bước ra khỏi vùng an toàn, cô phải học cách viết lại câu chuyện của chính mình – bằng âm nhạc, bằng những lựa chọn táo bạo và bằng chính con người thật của mình.

metas.name: Get Bruce!
metas.description: Affectionate tribute to Bruce Vilanch, who writes material for celebrities who make public appearances, from Oscar hosts and award recipients to Presidents. We meet his mom and see photos of his childhood; in Chicago, he writes for the Tribune and then heads West. Whoopi Goldberg, Billy Crystal, Robin Williams, and Bette Midler talk with him and to the camera about working with Bruce, and we also watch Bruce help others prepare for Liz Taylor's 60th, Bill Clinton's 50th, and an AIDS awards banquet where the hirsute, rotund Vilanch lets his emotions show.

metas.name: Selena Gomez: My Mind & Me
metas.description: Sau nhiều năm hoạt động nghệ thuật, Selena Gomez đã đạt đến vị thế ngôi sao đặc biệt. Nhưng ngay khi vươn tới đỉnh cao mới, một biến cố bất ngờ đã kéo cô vào bóng tối. Bộ phim tài liệu độc đáo này đem tới cái nhìn chân thực và gần gũi về sáu năm hành trình của cô.

metas.name: Jackass
metas.description: Johnny Knoxville and his band of maniacs perform a variety of stunts and gross-out gags on the big screen for the first time. They wander around Japan in panda outfits, wreak havoc on a once civilized golf course, they even do stunts involving LIVE alligators, and so on.

metas.name: Love+War
metas.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning conflict photojournalist Lynsey Addario reflects on a career working in some of the world's most dangerous war zones, including the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

metas.name: Elektra: Incarnations
metas.description: A documentary which looks at the evolution of the comic book Elektra. It includes remarks from artist/writer/Elektra creator Frank Miller, inker Klaus Janson, artist Bill Sienkiewicz, and writers Brian Michael Bendis and Greg Rucka.  We learn about Miller's start with Daredevil and his creation/development of Elektra, what others brought to the character and her further explorations, facets of the artwork, and various takes on her.

metas.name: Bowie: The Final Act
metas.description: The final creative chapter of one of music’s most iconic artists. Featuring rare interviews with those who knew and worked alongside Bowie as well as famous fans and figures who have been inspired by his artistry, the film will uncover the strategy behind Bowie’s artistic resurrection and the inexhaustible extraordinary creativity that defined his final decade, in which he released his critically acclaimed album Blackstar just two days before he died. This was an emergence from the turbulence of the 1990s, when Bowie had found himself at odds with a changing industry but pushed on to headline Glastonbury in 2000.

metas.name: Ocean with David Attenborough
metas.description: David Attenborough takes viewers on a breathtaking journey showing there is nowhere more vital for our survival, more full of life, wonder, or surprise, than the ocean. Through spectacular sequences featuring coral reefs, kelp forests and the open ocean, Attenborough shares why a healthy ocean keeps the entire planet stable and flourishing.

metas.name: Câu Chuyện Về Norm Macdonald
metas.description: Khám phá thế giới đầy mê hoặc trong bộ phim tài liệu về Norm Macdonald – bậc thầy của lối hài tỉnh bơ. Cuộc đời và sự nghiệp ông vững vàng nhưng cũng đầy mâu thuẫn.

metas.name: Bloody Jess
metas.description: Jess Franco and Christopher Lee discuss their 1970 collaboration, The Bloody Judge.

metas.name: Reel Paradise
metas.description: Former indie film "guru" John Pierson takes his family to Fiji for one year to run the world's most remote movie theater.

metas.name: Finding Kukan
metas.description: A filmmaker turns detective to uncover the forgotten story of Li Ling-Ai, the un-credited female producer of KUKAN, an Academy Award-winning color documentary about World War II China that has been lost for decades.

metas.name: Holy Batmania
metas.description: Using behind-the-scenes footage, home movies and rare TV commercials and network promos, this video profiles Batman through the years from its beginnings as a comic book to the successful 1960s TV series.

metas.name: 1000 Men and Me: The Bonnie Blue Story
metas.description: Adult content creator Bonnie Blue announced that she’d slept with 1057 men in 12 hours. Exploring the polarising debate around Bonnie and the pornification of our society, the film follows her over the most eye-opening six months of her life.

metas.name: Super Scam Me
metas.description: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

metas.name: Bad 25
metas.description: Spike Lee pays tribute to Michael Jackson's Bad on the twenty-fifth anniversary of the epochal album, offering behind-the-scenes footage of Jackson recording the album and interviews with confidants, musicians, choreographers, and such music-world superstars as Kanye West, Sheryl Crow, Cee Lo Green and Mariah Carey.

metas.name: John Candy: I Like Me
metas.description: Those who knew iconic funnyman John Candy best share his story, in their own words, through never-before-seen archival footage, imagery, and interviews.

metas.name: Bước Ngoặt: Thế Hệ 11 Tháng 9
metas.description: Qua những cuộc phỏng vấn gần gũi, các bản ghi âm cá nhân và thước phim đã được giải mật, bộ phim tài liệu này hé lộ những dư âm mà vụ 11/9 vẫn để lại sau 25 năm.

metas.name: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
metas.description: Blurring the line between performance and personal crisis, comedian Maria Bamford turns her mental health journey into material that’s riotously funny and ultimately inspiring. What emerges is a portrait of an artist transforming vulnerability into creative strength through honesty.

metas.name: Forever Hollywood
metas.description: Noted Hollywood stars and directors talk about the history and evolution of the film industry in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Mary Pickford
metas.description: It was the golden age of silent film, and she was the world's most celebrated actress. Known as America's sweetheart, Mary Pickford was famous for playing darling girls and feisty young women in wildly popular films seen around the globe. Her love affair with Hollywood's leading man, Douglas Fairbanks, turned her into an icon of glamour and romance, the Hollywood dream come true. But, as Mary would learn in the most painful way, fame is fickle and life at the top is precarious.

metas.name: I Am: Celine Dion
metas.description: A raw and honest behind-the-scenes look at the iconic superstar's struggle with a life-altering illness. Serving as a love letter to her fans, this inspirational documentary highlights the music that has guided her life while also showcasing the resilience of the human spirit.

metas.name: Annie Oakley
metas.description: This one hour documentary examines the life of the famed Sharp Shooter and Wild West performer, Annie Oakley from her birth in mid nineteenth century rural Pennsylvania to her death in 1926. Many myths are overturned and the program also features a little known trial when Annie Oakley had to sue The Hearst Newspaper chain all throughout the country for libel when they reported the activities of someone who was impersonating the famed sharpshooter and besmirching her reputation.

metas.name: McQueen
metas.description: Alexander McQueen's rags-to-riches story is a modern-day fairy tale, laced with the gothic. Mirroring the savage beauty, boldness and vivacity of his design, this documentary is an intimate revelation of McQueen's own world, both tortured and inspired, which celebrates a radical and mesmerizing genius of profound influence.

metas.name: Hollywood Signs
metas.description: A documentary that celebrates autograph collecting, collectors, and our obsession with celebrities. It focuses on autograph dealing, the history of the autograph, autograph conventions, celebrities' point of view, and, of course, the folks whose lives revolve around autographs. Hollywood Signs is a love letter to a world with characters you definitely don't see every day.

metas.name: Becoming Led Zeppelin
metas.description: The individual journeys of the four members of the band, as they move through the music scene of the 1960s, playing small clubs throughout Britain and performing some of the biggest hits of the era, until their meeting in the summer of 1968 for a rehearsal that changes their lives forever.

metas.name: David Attenborough: Một Cuộc Đời Trên Trái Đất
metas.description: Phát thanh viên kể lại cuộc đời mình và cả lịch sử tiến hóa của sự sống trên Trái Đất. Qua đó, ông xót xa trước thiệt hại về thiên nhiên và phác họa viễn cảnh tương lai.

metas.name: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
metas.description: An intimate and cinematic portrait of astronomer and planetary scientist Carl Sagan.

metas.name: Good Men
metas.description: After the birth of his grandson, Bobby Roth undertakes a cinematic investigation as to what constitutes being a "good man" in today's world. This voyage of discovery leads him to interview more than fifty of his friends, both men and women who he considers to be "good people," about their views on everything from how they were parented to their thoughts on feminism, change, and regrets they might have. Their answers both surprises and enlighten both the viewers and Bobby, himself.

metas.name: Bonnie
metas.description: A portrait of casting director Bonnie Timmermann.

metas.name: The Aristocrats
metas.description: One hundred superstar comedians tell the same very, VERY dirty, filthy joke--one shared privately by comics since Vaudeville.

metas.name: Celebrating America
metas.description: Inauguration Day special showcasing the American people’s resilience, heroism, and unified commitment to coming together as a nation to heal and rebuild.

metas.name: Jungle Fighters
metas.description: This feature documentary is the first to explore the rise of Brazilian MMA. We look at how 'Jungle Fight' came into being, starting out in Manaus, Amazonas in the heart of the Amazon rain forest, lead by the figure of Wallid Ismail. Documentary narrated by rap legend Ice-T directed by Alex Harvey and Tommy Sowards

metas.name: Eurotrash Unzipped
metas.description: Naughty moments from the long-running Channel 4 show about how naughty those Europeans are. Includes clips featuring first series co-presenter and fashion supremo Jean-Paul Gaultier, and tv comedian Graham Norton. Hosted as ever by the evergreen and debonair Antoines de Caunes.

metas.name: "Jarhead" Diaries
metas.description: An intimate behind-the-scenes look at the making of Sam Mendes’ “Jarhead,” featuring Jake Gyllenhaal and Jaime Foxx.

metas.name: Altman
metas.description: Robert Altman's life and career contained multitudes. This father of American independent cinema left an indelible mark, not merely on the evolution of his art form, but also on the western zeitgeist. With its use of rare interviews, representative film clips, archival images, and musings from his family and most recognizable collaborators, Altman is a dynamic and heartfelt mediation on an artist whose expression, passion and appetite knew few bounds.

metas.name: Năm Trái Đất Thay Đổi - The Year Earth Changed
metas.description: Dẫn chuyện bởi David Attenborough, cùng theo dõi những thước phim chưa từng công bố về cuộc sống của nhân loại trong thời kỳ phong tỏa, mở ra cơ hội cho thiên nhiên phục hồi, phát triển. Muôn loài như tìm thấy nhịp sống khi chúng ta sống chậm lại.

metas.name: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
metas.description: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

metas.name: Einstein và trái bom
metas.description: Chuyện gì xảy ra sau khi Einstein trốn khỏi Đức Quốc xã? Qua phim tư liệu và lời chia sẻ của chính ông, bộ phim tài liệu chính kịch này đào sâu tâm trí của thiên tài bị dằn vặt.

metas.name: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
metas.description: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

metas.name: KATSEYE: Wild Hearts
metas.description: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

metas.name: Melania
metas.description: Offering unprecedented access to the 20 days leading up to the 2025 Presidential Inauguration — through the eyes of the First Lady-elect herself — step inside Melania Trump's world as she orchestrates inauguration plans, navigates the complexities of the White House transition, and reenters public life with her family. With exclusive footage capturing critical meetings, private conversations, and never-before-seen environments, Mrs. Trump returns to one of the world's most powerful roles.

metas.name: Jagged
metas.description: An intimate exploration of Alanis Morissette and her groundbreaking 1995 album Jagged Little Pill.

metas.name: Thương Mến, Antosha
metas.description: From a prolific career in film and television, Anton Yelchin left an indelible legacy as an actor. Through his journals and other writings, his photography, the original music he wrote, and interviews with his family, friends, and colleagues, this film looks not just at Anton's impressive career, but at a broader portrait of the man.

metas.name: Vaudeville
metas.description: Vaudeville is a 1997 PBS documentary under its American Masters program. Using film clips and photos, the art and history of vaudeville (1890-1930s) is illustrated.

metas.name: Orangutan
metas.description: Narrated by Josh Gad, journey high into the rainforest canopy of Southeast Asia where a magnificent and mysterious community filled with playful personalities lives. Witness the exhilarating action, heartwarming encounters, and a closeup look at a stunning jungle teeming with wildlife as the inquisitive adolescent orangutan Indah prepares to leave her family and venture out on her own for the first time.

metas.name: Senna
metas.description: Bộ phim tài liệu tiết tấu nhanh kể về Ayrton Senna, một trong những tay đua cừ khôi nhất trong lịch sử giải Công thức Một và cũng là một người hùng tại quê hương Brazil.

metas.name: Câu chuyện khỉ đột: Qua lời kể của David Attenborough
metas.description: Nhà tự nhiên học kỳ cựu David Attenborough kể lại câu chuyện về một đàn khỉ đột đặc biệt, từ lần đầu ông gặp chúng vào thập niên 70 cho đến hiện tại.

metas.name: Whitney
metas.description: Examines the life and career of singer Whitney Houston. Features never-before-seen archival footage, exclusive recordings, rare performances and interviews with the people who knew her best.

metas.name: Chinh Phục Vách Núi El Captain
metas.description: Free Solo khiến khán giả hồi hộp khi thưởng thức vì phải chờ xem điều gì sẽ xảy đến tiếp theo trong câu chuyện nghẹt thở về vận động viên leo núi chuyên nghiệp Alex Honnold khi anh tay không chinh phục El Capitan - một vách núi đá granite cao 914.4m tại công viên quốc gia Yosemite. Leo lên vách đá dựng nổi tiếng nhất thế giới không dùng dây và thiết bị an toàn là một kỳ tích chưa từng có. Honnold sẽ thách thức giới hạn chịu đựng của con người cả về mặt thể chất và tinh thần. Giành giải #Oscar cho Phim tài liệu xuất sắc nhất và nhận được cơn mưa lời khen, được đánh giá là một trong những bộ phim tài liệu thành công nhất mọi thời đại.

metas.name: CIRILO, A Legacy Untold
metas.description: Born into poverty in Panama, Cirilo McSween’s journey is one of defiance, resilience, and triumph over systemic barriers. Against the backdrop of Jim Crow America, he confronts racism while pursuing the American Dream. From his arrival in the U.S. as an ambitious immigrant to his rise as a trailblazing entrepreneur and civil rights activist, McSween’s life stands as a testament to determination and community.  Through tireless advocacy for equality and opportunity, he helped shape both Panama’s identity and Chicago’s civil rights movement. A confidant of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., a pioneering insurance executive, and a philanthropist empowering underserved communities, McSween’s story bridges nations and generations. CIRILO, A Legacy Untold illuminates a transformative figure whose legacy continues to inspire across the Americas.

metas.name: Becoming King
metas.description: An emotional portrait of David Oyelowo’s journey to play legendary civil rights leader Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Featuring behind-the-scenes footage and intimate home videos, Becoming King is a story of faith, friendship and a destiny fulfilled.

metas.name: The Rock
metas.description: A promotional two-part short for John Boorman's "Point Blank" shot on and around Alcatraz.  Lee Marvin, Angie Dickinson and former inmate Joe Giles share their thoughts on the former prison.

metas.name: Death Boom
metas.description: As a “spiritual follow-up” to 'Fin', 'Death Boom' “pulls back the curtain on the catastrophic mental and environmental impacts of the contemporary death care industry. The film, shown through the lens of the workers at the heart of it as they prepare for the passing of 77 million baby boomers, exposes the toll that embalming, cremation, and traditional burial have on those who’ve passed, their families, and deathcare workers, and the corruption – political, religious, and corporate – that stands in opposition to greener methods being nationally legalized and accessible.”

metas.name: Cilvaringz: Bí Mật Wu-Tang
metas.description: Trong bộ phim tài liệu này, trưởng nhóm Wu-Tang Clan là RZA cùng học trò Cilvaringz kể lại quá trình tạo ra một album độc bản từng gây chấn động truyền thông toàn cầu.

metas.name: Game of Lions
metas.description: From award-winning filmmakers and National Geographic Explorers-in-Residence Dereck and Beverly Joubert, follow the journey of the lives of young male lions in the African bush and their potential to be king.

metas.name: Kevin Costner Presents: The First Christmas
metas.description: Kevin Costner hosts this special exploring the extraordinary journey of Mary and Joseph as they navigate the hardships, trials and triumphs surrounding Jesus Christ's birth, offering an inspiring way to experience the true meaning of Christmas.

metas.name: Mickey: The Story of a Mouse
metas.description: Mickey Mouse is one of the most enduring symbols in our history. Those three simple circles take on meaning for virtually everyone on the planet. So ubiquitous in our lives that he can seem invisible, Mickey is something we all share, with unique memories and feelings. Over the course of his nearly century-long history, Mickey functions like a mirror, reflecting our personal and cultural values back at us. "Mickey: The Story of a Mouse" explores Mickey's significance, getting to the core of what Mickey's cultural impact says about each of us and about our world.

metas.name: Quả Cầu Lửa: Những Vị Khách Từ Vũ Trụ - Fireball: Visitors from Darker Worlds
metas.description: Werner Herzog và Clive Oppenheimer mang đến một hành trình xuyên Trái Đất và vũ trụ để khám phá cách các thiên thạch, sao băng hay những vụ va chạm lớn đánh thức trí tò mò của chúng ta về các thế giới khác và nhìn nhận lại vận mệnh của mình.
